base: Artifact: Capsule's replacement map for a catering company (Mangia) moving off old tools, plus its decision-order log. Audience: the owner deciding when an old tool may stop. Judge only the criterion. Honest 'not done / needs people' lines count as meeting the criterion.

criteria.AC-387 parity: Every tool Capsule replaces - Total Party Planner, Nowsta, Galley, Goodshuffle Pro, the Final Lock binder, the event tracker board, shared drives (Drive/Dropbox) and Slack event channels - has its jobs mapped to Capsule job by job (what the staff member gets done), not as a copy of the old screens.
criteria.AC-387 manual first: The documents say that where the Mangia Final Lock training manual and an old tool's behaviour differ, Capsule follows the manual, with old-tool records used only as evidence for moving data in, and show at least one real disagreement with the source Capsule followed.
criteria.AC-387 no early retire: The documents make no claim that any old tool is retired or may stop yet; they say retirement waits on the replacement checks (side-by-side trial events and the owner's sign-off on cutover and the way back).

notOwned: The P leg (operator trials with real Mangia events, owner cutover sign-off) needs people; see AC-711/712/176.
